limitations: Primary roster: NHDES labs-private-wells.pdf titled Water Testing Guidance for New Hampshire Private Well Users; document header April 2026; PDF metadata ModDate 20 Apr 2026; footer states Lab list updated 9/20/2024. Retrieved 20 September 2026. For up-to-date accreditation status use Accredited Laboratory Search.

PDF lists laboratories that serve New Hampshire private well users — commercial private-well acceptance treated as yes per that NHDES list; still call to confirm current packages, hold times, and fees.
NHDHHS Public Health Laboratories appears on the PDF and is documented as the verified state homeowner path (not duplicated in the commercial table).
Fees intentionally omitted — confirm with each lab / WAL.
Accredited Laboratory Search is a live JS database; search-page HTML archived but live result set not scraped into a table tonight.
Portsmouth city mirror PDF (Search Date September 25, 2024) and Plaistow town PDF (updated 3/10/2020) archived for context only — not used as the roster.

verified_paths.name: NHDHHS Public Health Laboratories — Water Analysis Laboratory (WAL) Homeowner Water Testing
verified_paths.notes: WAL Program states it provides comprehensive fee-for-service testing for analytes in private wells of New Hampshire homeowners; homeowners receive a full report with interpretation. Contact printed on WAL contact page: 29 Hazen Drive, Concord NH 03301; Waterlab@dhhs.nh.gov; 603-271-3445. Also listed on NHDES labs-private-wells.pdf. Fees intentionally omitted — confirm with WAL. Note retrieved 20 Sep 2026: WAL will not accept bacteria samples on Friday, September 25 (upcoming schedule notice on WAL program page).

verified_paths.name: NHDES Home Owner Container Request (kits / bottles for WAL tests)
verified_paths.notes: Official DES Onestop form to request homeowner test containers. Form options verified on page include Standard Analysis, Radiological Analysis, Volatile Organic Chemicals, Drinking Water Bacteria, Basic Analysis, Fluoride, NH Well Water Test For Home Buyers, Standard Analysis Plus Radon, Radon Only, Arsenic Only, Lead Only (for service line ID), and Other. Linked from WAL program as Test Containers for Homeowners. Confirm current kit contents, hold times, and fees with WAL before collecting.
